exposure: Type of surgical intervention (primary fascial closure, sutured silo)
cohort: A cohort of 62 gastroschisis patients admitted to Hospital Central Maputo in Maputo City, Mozambique, from 2019 to 2020.
finding: The overall survival rate for gastroschisis patients was 5%, but improved to 20% for those who underwent an attempt at surgical closure.
birth_weight: 68% of infants had low birth weight.
